_about: Sample recall benchmark. Each query is phrased to AVOID the target memory's distinctive words, so keyword (FTS) search struggles and semantic recall has room to help. Intentionally cross-domain. Replace with your own {memories,queries} to benchmark on your data: `mycelium eval --dataset mine.json`.

memories.content: Our API access tokens auto-renew through the refresh grant whenever under 24 hours of validity remain.
The database kept refusing new clients during traffic spikes until we put PgBouncer in front and raised the ceiling.
A background worker kept getting OOM-killed; we bumped its memory limit and added a liveness probe.
The wild-yeast leaven is ripe for baking once it doubles, roughly four hours at room temperature.
Parked the rainy-day savings in a low-fee total-market fund so it grows instead of sitting idle.
The lower-back tweak came from rounding during heavy pulls; bracing and keeping the bar close fixed it.
Renewal runs about six weeks by mail; the expedited option cuts it to roughly two for an extra fee.
Release builds were enormous until we stripped symbols and turned on link-time optimization in the profile.
Cutting screens an hour before bed and a cooler bedroom finally fixed the trouble drifting off.
Tidied the messy history before merging by squashing the work-in-progress commits into one.
The fiddle-leaf drops foliage when overwatered; let the top inch of soil dry out between waterings.
Switching to a coarser grind made the bitter, over-extracted taste go away.
Contributing to the retirement account before the cutoff lowers this year's taxable income.
The site threw a security warning because the certificate had lapsed; the ACME client now auto-renews it.
Standups got shorter once status moved to written async updates and the call was kept for blockers only.
Lost a day of work to a crash, so now everything important syncs to an offsite copy each night.
A dull blade is more dangerous than a sharp one; honing before each session keeps the cuts clean.
Logging every expense for a month showed most of the leak was small recurring charges.
Nodes on the two separate mesh networks can't reach each other; use the LAN addresses instead.
The afternoon headaches mostly stopped once I started drinking more water through the day.
Recruiters skim for outcomes, not duties; lead each line with a measurable result.
Kitchen scraps break down faster when you balance greens with browns and turn the pile weekly.
